retrievalProfile.description: A centered square portrait framed in blue against a solid black field, featuring contrasting uncial-style display text and modern geometric sans-serif subtext.
triggerTerms: centered framed photo on black background
uncial display title with geometric subtext

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring a central square photograph of a musician with a guitar, enclosed in a thin blue border. The layout is anchored by a solid black background, with a stylized orange title at the top and a clean, light blue name at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Central framed image as the primary focal point
Top-aligned display title in warm orange
Bottom-aligned artist name in cool light blue
Symmetrical vertical alignment across all elements
coreInvariants: Thin blue rectangular frame around the central image
Strict vertical centering of all text and image elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central square photograph, occupying approximately 40% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top orange title, moves down to the central image, and finishes at the bottom artist name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the central elements, creating a spotlight effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and vibrant, saturated text colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mixed: Uncial-inspired display and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses rounded, Celtic-influenced uncial forms with thick strokes
Artist name uses wide, monolinear geometric sans-serif forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' in title has a distinctive looped descender
Artist name 'M' and 'W' are wide and square
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of organic, historical display type with modern, industrial geometric type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, historical feel of the title text.
Matches the wide, geometric structure of the artist name.
Alternative for the wide, clean sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black square canvas. Place a square photograph of a musician with a guitar in the center, surrounded by a thin, vibrant blue border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in a bold orange uncial font at the top center. Add the artist name in a wide, light blue geometric sans-serif font at the bottom center, just below the image frame.

verificationChecks: Is the central image framed in blue?
Is the top text orange and the bottom text blue?

adjustableVariables: Negative space between text and image
mustRedesign: Any logos or record label branding
Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the frame
Legible but highly stylized display type

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange title is in lowercase uncial style.
Ensure the blue name is in uppercase geometric sans-serif.
Verify the blue frame is perfectly square and centered.
Check that the black background is uniform and deep.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered square frame + Black field + Uncial top text + Geometric bottom text
